lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p15-16 - Point and say.

details: Point and say lets students demonstrate the language they have gained so far in the course and practise simple picture description by pointing to and identifying things they can see in the frames. It also helps to engage students in the story before they’ve listened.
Look for correct identification of the items in the frames they point at, clear and accurate pronunciation, with most students participating and able to identify at least some items in the frames.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p63 - Help Little Red Riding Hood get to Grandma’s house.

details: This activity helps students develop their problem-solving skills in order to identify the correct path to Grandma’s house.
Look for students following the paths with their fingers and correctly identifying the path with no obstacles on it.
